prompt: Which commands are O(N) and can stall a busy server when the collection or keyspace is large?
explanation: Everything that walks a whole collection or the whole keyspace is O(N): KEYS scans the keyspace, SMEMBERS serialises every member, and HGETALL serialises every field. GET reads one value and stays O(1) no matter how big the keyspace is.

options.text: SMEMBERS on a set with one million members
GET on a single large string value
HGETALL on a hash with five hundred thousand fields
